issue.title: Should we change session manager from tf.train.Supervisor to tf.train.MonitoredTrainingSession?
issue.body:
I always meet this error `Error reported to Coordinator: <class 'tensorflow.python.framework.errors_impl.UnavailableError'>, OS Error` in distributed_replicated mode. It will break the training program. But sometimes the error doesn't appear. It impacted my scheduling work a lot...
 I googled it, and in [tensorflow-issue-6780](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/6780), @yaroslavvb said when we meet UnavailableError, Supervisor won't restart session, just let the session down instead. MonitoredSession/MonitoredTraining session improve on Supervisor by adding retries in presence of UnavailableError.
So I wonder if we are going to change session manager from Supervisor to MonitoredTrainingSession?
